title: Nano Banana joins the image API
summary:
New ways to make images, ground answers in search, practice a language, and use DeepSeek V3.1.

Added `nanobanana` for text-to-image generation and image-to-image requests using one or more reference image URLs. A follow-up adjusted its prompt handling to steer Gemini toward producing images.

Added `gemini-search` on Gemini 2.5 Flash so callers do not have to supply the Google Search tool themselves. Follow-up fixes made the tool format compatible with Vertex AI and corrected Vertex model resolution and authentication initialization.

Added `chickytutor`, an anonymous-access, text-only language tutor. The same PR improved how model transforms carry options and messages through requests, and switched ad generation to Ko-fi ads.

daily.title: Nano Banana image generation
daily.text: Use `nanobanana` to generate an image from text or supply one or more reference image URLs for image-to-image requests. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=nanobanana).

daily.title: Gemini with search built in
daily.text: Use `gemini-search` for Gemini 2.5 Flash responses grounded with Google Search, without adding the search tool to your request. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-search).

daily.title: Practice with ChickyTutor
daily.text: Try `chickytutor`, a text-only language tutor available with anonymous access. [Explore the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=chickytutor).

daily.title: DeepSeek V3.1 added
